AnalysisType.description: Type of analysis performed on the dataset.
AnalysisType.title: AnalysisType

BRCOrganization.description: An organization involved in the dataset, such as a funder, an affiliation, or an organizational author. This may be any organization (a university, national laboratory, consortium, or agency), not only a Bioenergy Research Center. The name denotes that this is the BRC schema's model of an organization, rather than the one defined by OSTI, though the classes are similar.
BRCOrganization.title: BRCOrganization

CitedItemType.description: Type of cited item, e.g., journal article.
CitedItemType.title: CitedItemType

Contributor.description: An individual who contributed to the dataset in some manner, not necessarily as an author.

affiliations.description: All affiliations of the individual, in the order given by the source record. Affiliations may be any organization, not only a Bioenergy Research Center: for example, a GLBRC member may list both Great Lakes Bioenergy Research Center and University of Michigan. Matches the affiliations of a Person in OSTI E-Link 2.0 (name and ROR ID).

individual_roles.description: Roles this individual holds for the dataset, such as first author, contributing author, or corresponding author. More than one individual may hold the same role (e.g., co-first authors), and one individual may hold several roles (e.g., a first author who is also the corresponding author). When no creator is explicitly marked FirstAuthor, the first creator in the list is taken to be the first author. These roles have no equivalent in the OSTI E-Link 2.0 schema, so they are not carried over to OSTI records; author order is preserved there through list order.

orcid.description: ORCID for the individual. This should include the full URI with prefix, e.g., https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097.

primaryContact.description: Indicates if the individual is a primary contact.

Contributor.title: Contributor

ContributorTypeCodes.description: The type of contribution. These values are based on the OSTI schema (ELINK 241.6).
ContributorTypeCodes.title: ContributorTypeCodes

Dataset.description: A body of structured information describing some topic or topics of interest. This includes metadata about the dataset.

abstract.description: "A brief abstract summarizing the dataset. This will generally be longer and more detailed than the description but should not exceed a single paragraph."

active.description: Indicates whether the dataset is active or inactive. This is a boolean field - true indicates active, false indicates inactive.

additional_brcs.description: Additional Bioenergy Research Center affiliations. This is a list of one or more additional BRC names, for instances in which the dataset is associated with multiple centers.

alert.description: Indicates whether availability of the dataset has encountered some inconsistency. This is a boolean field - true indicates alert, false indicates no alert. For example, if we have a Dataset object but the Dataset is missing from its source feed, this should be set to true.

analysisType.description: The type of analysis performed on the dataset.

brc.description: The primary Bioenergy Research Center affiliation. This is a single BRC name. Legacy datasets from the BioEnergy Science Center (BESC) use CBI, as CBI is BESC's successor.

category.description: Category of the dataset. This is specific to the BRCs and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of categories.

conference_date.description: Date or date range for the conference.

conference_information.description: General conference information related to the dataset.

conference_type.description: Code representing the type of conference-related work.

contributors.description: Contributors to the dataset who are not necessarily authors.

country_publication.description: Human-readable country of publication, if available.

country_publication_code.description: Country code for the publication venue, if applicable.

creator.description: List of individual creators (authors) involved in the dataset, where one must be the primary contact. The list is ordered: creators appear in author order, matching the order of AUTHOR persons in the corresponding OSTI record. Use individual_roles on each creator to label first, contributing, and corresponding authors explicitly, for example when there are co-first authors. A dataset must have creator, organizational_creators, or both.

datasetName.description: "Name of a overall dataset to which this data entry belongs."

datasetType.description: High-level type of the main content of the dataset.

dataset_url.description: URL for the dataset landing page.

date.description: The date the dataset was created or published.

description.description: A detailed description of the dataset.

geolocations.description: Geographic locations associated with the dataset, such as field sites, sampling locations, or study areas. Each entry is a single point, a bounding box, or a polygon, so a dataset collected at several sites lists one entry per site. Matches the geolocations of an OSTI E-Link 2.0 record, which supports lists of points, boxes, and polygons; accuracy and altitude are BRC additions.

has_related_ids.description: "Related identifiers for the dataset. These should be identifiers to records in other repositories, and these records may be the same data or components of the dataset."

id.description: Unique identifier for the dataset, assigned prior to inclusion in bioenergy.org.

issue.description: Issue number for a journal or other venue, if applicable.

journal_issn.description: International Standard Serial Number for the journal, if known.

journal_license_url.description: URL for information regarding the journal license.

journal_name.description: Name of the journal publishing this information.

journal_open_access_flag.description: Indicates whether the journal is open access.

journal_type.description: Specific sub-type of the journal article.

media.description: Media bundles and file-package metadata associated with the dataset.

ontology_annotations.description: Structured ontology term annotations that align this dataset with controlled vocabulary or ontology classes.

organizational_creators.description: Organizations credited as authors of the dataset, such as consortia, collaborations, or institutions. The list is ordered, and is kept separate from creator, matching OSTI E-Link 2.0, which lists organizations with type AUTHOR apart from AUTHOR persons. A dataset must have creator, organizational_creators, or both.

plasmid_features.description: Description of plasmid features, if applicable. This is a multivalued field.

publication_date_text.description: Textual representation of the publication date, if used.

repository.description: The repository where the dataset is stored.

species.description: Species information for the organism(s) studied.

theme.description: High-level theme areas for the dataset. This is specific to the research themes of the BRCs.

topic.description: High-level topic area for the dataset. This is specific to the BRCs and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of topics.

volume.description: Volume number for a journal or book, if applicable.

Dataset.title: Dataset

DatasetCollection.description: Container class for defining a collection of datasets.

datasets.description: List of datasets in the collection.

schema_version.description: Version of the schema used for the collection.

DatasetCollection.title: DatasetCollection

DatasetThemeEnum.description: High-level theme area for the dataset. This is specific to the research themes of the BRCs.
DatasetThemeEnum.title: DatasetThemeEnum

DatasetTopicEnum.description: High-level topic area for the dataset. This is specific to the BRCs and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of topics. Where a close match exists, each value notes the corresponding OSTI subject category code (see https://www.osti.gov/) used when records are submitted to OSTI.
DatasetTopicEnum.title: DatasetTopicEnum

DatasetTypeCodes.description: High-level type of the main content of the dataset, following OSTI categories. See https://www.osti.gov/elink/F2416instruct.jsp
DatasetTypeCodes.title: DatasetTypeCodes

Funding.description: Funding source for the dataset. Each item corresponds to a single award or grant.

awardNumber.description: Award number from the funding entity.

awardURI.description: URI for the award. This may be a DOI. Include prefix.

Funding.title: Funding

GeoPoint.description: A single geographic point, in WGS 84 decimal degrees, with an optional altitude. Mirrors the point structure of OSTI E-Link 2.0, which has latitude and longitude only.

altitude.description: Altitude in meters above mean sea level. Negative values are below sea level. Not part of the OSTI schema, so it is not carried over to OSTI records.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from -90 to 90 inclusive. Positive values are north of the equator.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from -180 to 180 inclusive. Positive values are east of the prime meridian.

GeoPoint.title: GeoPoint

Geolocation.description: A geographic location associated with a dataset: a single point, a bounding box, or a polygon. Coordinates are WGS 84 decimal degrees. This mirrors the OSTI E-Link 2.0 Geolocation structure, adding optional accuracy values. Many legacy coordinates were backfilled from place names or site descriptions, so leave the accuracy slots empty when the accuracy is not known rather than guessing.

geolocation_type.description: The shape of this geolocation. Optional, as the shape can be determined from the points: one point is a POINT; two points, the northwest and southeast corners, are a BOX; four or more points are a POLYGON. A POLYGON should begin and end on the same point, so that the shape is closed.

horizontal_accuracy.description: Horizontal accuracy of the coordinates, in meters: the radius within which the true location is expected to lie. Applies to every point in this geolocation. Not part of the OSTI schema, so it is not carried over to OSTI records.

label.description: Place name for this location or set of points.

points.description: The points defining this location, in order. One point for a POINT, two (northwest corner, then southeast corner) for a BOX, and four or more for a POLYGON, with the first point repeated as the last.

vertical_accuracy.description: Vertical accuracy of the altitude values, in meters. Applies to every point in this geolocation that has an altitude. Not part of the OSTI schema, so it is not carried over to OSTI records.

Geolocation.title: Geolocation

GeolocationTypeEnum.description: The shape of a geolocation. Matches the OSTI E-Link 2.0 geolocation types.
GeolocationTypeEnum.title: GeolocationTypeEnum

Individual.description: An individual involved in the dataset.

affiliations.description: All affiliations of the individual, in the order given by the source record. Affiliations may be any organization, not only a Bioenergy Research Center: for example, a GLBRC member may list both Great Lakes Bioenergy Research Center and University of Michigan. Matches the affiliations of a Person in OSTI E-Link 2.0 (name and ROR ID).

individual_roles.description: Roles this individual holds for the dataset, such as first author, contributing author, or corresponding author. More than one individual may hold the same role (e.g., co-first authors), and one individual may hold several roles (e.g., a first author who is also the corresponding author). When no creator is explicitly marked FirstAuthor, the first creator in the list is taken to be the first author. These roles have no equivalent in the OSTI E-Link 2.0 schema, so they are not carried over to OSTI records; author order is preserved there through list order.

orcid.description: ORCID for the individual. This should include the full URI with prefix, e.g., https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097.

primaryContact.description: Indicates if the individual is a primary contact.

Individual.title: Individual

IndividualRoleEnum.description: Roles an individual may hold for a dataset, particularly with respect to authorship.
IndividualRoleEnum.title: IndividualRoleEnum

MediaFile.description: Metadata about a particular file or off-site resource associated with a dataset. This mirrors the OSTI media-file structure to preserve file-level details.

checksum.description: Checksum value for the file, if known.

date_file_added.description: Date this media file was created.

date_file_updated.description: Date this media file was last modified.

document_page_count.description: Page count for document-based media, if applicable.

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds for audio-visual media.

file_size_bytes.description: File size in bytes, if applicable.

media_file_id.description: Unique identifier for this media file.

media_id.description: Identifier of the parent media set.

media_source.description: Method of file production or association.

media_type.description: Type code for this media file.

mime_type.description: MIME type describing this media file.

parent_media_file_id.description: Identifier of the parent media file, if this file is derived.

pdf_version.description: PDF version, if this file is a PDF.

revision.description: Revision number of this media file.

subtitle_tracks.description: Number of subtitle tracks for audio-visual media.

url.description: Local file name or off-site URL.

video_tracks.description: Number of video tracks for audio-visual media.

MediaFile.title: MediaFile

MediaSet.description: Metadata about a group of files associated with this dataset. This mirrors the OSTI media-set structure to preserve package-level details.

access_limitations.description: Access limitation codes associated with this media set.

date_added.description: Date the media set was first created.

date_updated.description: Date the media set was most recently modified.

date_valid_end.description: Date when the media association ended, if applicable.

document_page_count.description: Number of pages detected in the media set, if applicable.

files.description: Files associated with this media set.

media_id.description: Unique identifier for this media set.

media_source.description: Primary source of the media set.

media_title.description: Optional title for the media set.

mime_type.description: MIME type description for the primary media content.

osti_id.description: OSTI record identifier linked to this media set, if any.

revision.description: Revision number of this media set.

MediaSet.title: MediaSet

OntologyAnnotation.description: A structured reference to an ontology term used to annotate a dataset. This captures both the local display name used in BRC metadata and the canonical label used by the source ontology.

canonical_name.description: Canonical label used for this term in its source ontology.

preferred_name.description: Preferred display name for this ontology annotation in BRC metadata.

term_id.description: Ontology term identifier in CURIE format, such as BERVO:8000232.

OntologyAnnotation.title: OntologyAnnotation

Organism.description: An organism studied in the dataset.

NCBITaxID.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID for the organism, as a bare integer (e.g., 3694 for Populus trichocarpa).

strains.description: Name of one or more strains of the organism.

taxon_ids.description: Taxonomic or genome identifiers for the organism from sources other than NCBI Taxonomy, as CURIEs. Supported prefixes are GOLD (JGI Genomes OnLine Database IDs, e.g., GOLD:Gp0004954; organism IDs begin with Go, sequencing project IDs with Gp) and IMG.TAXON (JGI IMG taxon OIDs, which are integers). Use NCBITaxID for NCBI Taxonomy identifiers.

Organism.title: Organism

Plasmid.description: Description of plasmid or other molecular vector features.

backbone.description: Name of the backbone of the plasmid, e.g., pUC19.

description.description: Description of the plasmid, including any relevant features not captured in other fields.

host.description: Host organism for the plasmid, e.g., E. coli. Includes both the scientific name and NCBI Taxonomy ID.

id.description: Unique identifier for the plasmid. This must be unique within the dataset.

ori.description: Origin of replication for the plasmid, e.g., ColE1.

promoters.description: Promoters for the plasmid, e.g., T7.

replicates_in.description: Organism(s) in which the plasmid replicates. Includes both the scientific name and NCBI Taxonomy ID.

selection_markers.description: Selection markers for the plasmid, e.g, kan.

Plasmid.title: Plasmid

RelatedItem.description: A related publication or item, including cited publications.

relatedItemIdentifier.description: Identifier or URL for the related item.

relatedItemType.description: Type of the related item, e.g., JournalArticle.

RelatedItem.title: RelatedItem

RepositoryEnum.title: RepositoryEnum
